offer.text: The militia needs shields and my hands are full. Craft 2 of them and I'll pay for the labour.

accept.text: Plank and iron — you know the pattern. Good.

decline.text: The recruits will have to duck, then.

ready.text: Two sturdy shields. The watch will stand a little safer.

complete.text: Fine craftsmanship. There's a place for you at this anvil.
